headline: Policy rate kept at 9.50%, three-month monetary policy announced
summary: Bangladesh's policy rate has been kept at 9.50%, and a three-month monetary policy has been announced. The decision sets the central bank's stance on interest rates for the coming period.
why: The policy rate anchors borrowing costs and inflation expectations in the economy, guiding banks' lending and deposit rates.
